requiredBehavior: run only from an owner-authenticated issue command on release issue 3072

allow the fixed prerequisite command /production p0-reviewer-membership-repair deployed-30d9075 only for exact already deployed revision 30d9075d8867fa60b3ec275b1e244f151debf0f4; arbitrary SHA input is forbidden

before and after the reviewer repair require both production API and Web OCI revisions to remain exactly 30d9075d8867fa60b3ec275b1e244f151debf0f4 and require that revision to remain an ancestor of repository main

the reviewer repair may call only the existing no-argument auth.repair_single_reviewer_membership function through pc_staff_runtime inside SERIALIZABLE execution and may change only the fixed internal organization, one reviewer membership, immutable staff audit and durable outbox evidence

the reviewer repair must not create or change identity, staff assignment, password, MFA factor, session, customer tenant, deployment, privilege, arbitrary SQL surface or recurring cost and must publish no PII, credential or raw database message
for the live customer journey resolve exact current main before every external action
use the public production Web BFF for registration, verification, login, MFA, logout and the permitted first action
